The original left/right daughter pair is reflowed to upper/lower to fit the page. Two separate complete cells each contain one intact nucleus, one noncountable loose chromatin region cue and one centrosome. The external key retains two single-DNA chromosomes per daughter; bends of the loose cue do not enumerate them. No new S phase is asserted. Every centrosome retains two separate perpendicular centriole carriers, simplified from narrow closed rods to 13 mm centreline strokes. Their 36 mm PCM circles are enlarged independently; this is a didactic layout with no physical organelle-scale claim.
